name: bounded physical cost guard v1
reason: Original shared ledger is 93/120 dollar-labelled request reservations, not actual billing. Preserve it; use separate usage-based cap for next bounded physical runs.
planned_scope: D01 repair, up to two B5 attempts, and one operator D01 completion; at most eight requests per original runner, total at most 32 new requests.
cost_rates: Same official standard rates as reviewed night guard; returned input/cache/output usage settles reservation. Unknown/error usage keeps reservation.
data_scope: Only existing physical runner nominal design, tools and new bounded measurement summaries; no raw ADC, photographs, assembly details or local file contents.
activation: Later explicit run --bench physical --provider meta --execute plus all original fresh operator, reviewed-design, boot and publication guards. No automatic hardware execution.
changes: Declared HTTP client and separate accounting paths only. No source changes to physical runners, firmware, fitting or model prompts. No retries.
